# Mechanical Plans and Air Distribution

**Document:** PSD-M-202
**Revision:** 0
**Status:** Issued for proposal

The plan shows the emergency operations unit, smoke dampers, and access doors.
The north riser note still states “75% emergency fan duty,” a carry-forward
note from the preliminary design. The current PSD-M-201 schedule states 100%
emergency fan duty. No later issued document explains which value is intended
for the north riser.

The plan also shows a shaft penetration at the service yard. Coordinate the
firestopping and access arrangement with PSD-ARC-101 and PSD-ADD-001.
